criteria.title: WhatsApp als optioneel kanaal aansluiten
criteria.doneWhen: WhatsApp kan via een toegelaten werkelijke verbinding dezelfde Eva, persoonscontext, opdrachten en oorspronkelijke resultaatbinding gebruiken. Aan-/uitschakelen en verbindingsstatus zijn bedienbaar; geen verplicht account voor andere gebruikers.

review_scope.independent_review: Child reviewed coordinator-owned core API, current-owner binding, original-result source reader, shared route allowances and owner UI. Child did not edit these files.
review_scope.transport_review: Coordinator reviewed child-owned deploy/whatsapp-bridge implementation. This reviewer authored that transport and does not represent its own tests as independent review.
review_scope.installation: Final helper source was independently compared byte-for-byte with the healthy running core. This does not independently establish every image/configuration invariant or real external WhatsApp use.

findings.finding: Owner authority could change during settings body intake before a bridge mutation.
findings.fix: The thread dispatch rechecks authorize(request) immediately before control.call. Dedicated late-revocation test confirms zero bridge mutation.

findings.finding: Audio disable or authority change during PCM upload could still start transcription.
findings.fix: Fresh media_session and original-session media.check execute after body intake and before STT. Dedicated test confirms no STT call.

conclusions: The current canonical owner, not a phone-derived new principal, supplies the private ConversationTurn and existing runtime response route.
Result returns reuse existing scoped work claim/authorize/ack; WhatsApp route syntax is strict and exact episode/source bindings remain required.

Digital work uses its retained source. Legacy research/tool-free work uses integrity-checked existing ingress at immutable creation time and an exact deterministic command/action creation key; generation ancestry is bounded. Failure to prove origin rejects return rather than choosing a recent message.
Background transport receives only a600-character summary plus full stored result hashes for authorization.
Media uses existing speech input/output ports with bounded PCM and encoded synthesis. No voice implementation or second agent was introduced.
Owner UI uses same-origin no-store requests, fixed QR data-URL validation, hidden/unmount clearing and explicit actions. It states the unofficial Baileys transport and optional account requirement.

The final legacy source reader scopes the ingress query through service.conversation_scope and PostgresOperationalTimeline._scope, independently of work storage scope. All four logical tenant/installation/principal/conversation source fields must match; _SourceTurnLoader verifies the current durable private ingress and current authority before returning its message ID.

coordinator_real_postgres_tests.observation: Reread final helper/test and retained stdout. Parametrized actual PostgreSQL proof covers equal and separated storage/conversation namespaces, with scoped return claim, exact origin, authorization, acknowledgment and wrong-contact isolation.

transport_tests.scope: Synthetic sockets/core and local HTTP only; real SDK auth serialization and local ffmpeg; no external WhatsApp or model requests.

independent_installed_context_alignment.scope: Read-only docker exec SHA-256 of installed whatsapp_context.py and docker inspect core state. No model, private conversation, QR or external message read.

limitations: No real external WhatsApp account pairing, incoming message, quoted reply or background delivery is proven by this source review.
E2.6 doneWhen requires a permitted actual connection; card completion must wait for installed/real-use evidence.
No family acceptance, general conversational quality, live telephone call or universal speech availability is claimed.
Uncertain transport sends remain ambiguous and are never blindly replayed. Confirmed delivery with a lost core acknowledgment retries only the idempotent acknowledgment.
The child transport global console sink addresses libsignal session-object logging identified by the coordinator; no QR/session/credential logs are acceptable.

deployment_note.observed_failure: Coordinator reported installed bridge refused startup with private_storage_required. Compose runtime UID65532 matched the existing core secret; the fresh image volume was seeded with UID1000 ownership.
deployment_note.targeted_fix: Dockerfile now runs UID65532:GID65532 and seeds /var/lib/eva-whatsapp with UID65532:GID65532 and mode0700. README runtime ownership matches. No SDK, transport or voice logic changed.
deployment_note.validation_boundary: Source ownership directives inspected. Actual installed startup and retained volume ownership still require coordinator verification; the original failed attempt remains evidence.
deployment_note.followup_observation: Coordinator subsequently reports the rebuilt bridge healthy and awaiting_qr, with media_available true. No external message or completed pairing is claimed. Reviewer independently observed the final core healthy and exact helper source bytes.
